issues.event: FDA approval of J&J's ICOTYDE (icotrokinra) for plaque psoriasis
issues.article_text: A J&J emplacou a icotroquinra (ICOTYDE), primeiro tratamento oral direcionado para psoríase moderada a grave — 70% atingiram pele limpa em 16 semanas, eliminando a necessidade de injeções.
issues.detail: FDA approved ICOTYDE on March 18, 2026. The research window for this edition opens March 19 at 10:00 BRT. Both the J&J press release and coverage (STAT, Healio, BioSpace) are dated March 18. Presented as news alongside the Wegovy HD and retatrutide stories, not as background context.
